title: Obsidian plugin was abused to deploy a remote access trojan
summary: Security researchers discovered that the Obsidian note-taking application's plugin system was exploited to distribute a remote access trojan called Phantom Pulse RAT, potentially compromising users who installed malicious plugins.
problem_solved: This is a security threat disclosure rather than a solution, exposing how a legitimate application's plugin ecosystem was weaponized for malware distribution.
why_valuable: Provides critical threat intelligence about supply chain attacks targeting productivity tools and raises awareness for developers and security teams about plugin-based attack vectors.
